Ex±HiβiTB DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOT RESTRICTIONS TWIN TOWER EQUITIES, LLC., having an address c/o BLDG Management, 52 Vanderbilt Avenue, New York, New York 10017 ("Grantor"), and PARK PLACE PARTNERS, LLC, having an office at 85 Worth Street, Suite 500, New York, New York 10013 ("Developer"), constituting the “parties in interest”(excepting those parties waiving their respective rights to join therein) as defined in Section 12-10(d) of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 as amended, with respect to land known as Tax Lots 39, 40, 41, 42 and 35 in Block 939 on the Tax Map of the City and State of New York, County of Kings, do hereby declare that the tract of land known as and by the street addresses 296-302Flatbush Avenue and 286-292 Flatbush Avenue a/k/a 135-149 Park Place, is to be treated as one zoning lot for the purpose of and in accordance with the provisions of the aforementioned Zoning Resolution effective December 15,1961,as amended. The said parcels of land are respectively described on Exhibit A annexed hereto, and comprise tax lots which are contiguous for more than ten (10) linear feet with intervening tax lots respectively adjacent thereto which will form a larger combined zoning lot. The said tax lots are located within a single block. Reference is made to the Zoning Lot and Development Agreement, made as of the date hereof, by Grantor and Developer and intended to be recorded in the office of the City Register in the County of New York, prior to the recording of this instrument, which agreement sets forth the rights and obligations of the parties thereto regarding the combinedzoninglot. No breach by any party to this Declaration of any agreement ancillary hereto shall have any effect on the treatment of said parcels as one combined zoning lot, and such parcels shall be treated as one combined zoning lot unless and until such zoning lot is hereafter subdivided in accordance with the provisions of the aforementioned Zoning Resolution.

This Declaration shall be recorded in the aforementioned office of the City Register in accordance with Section 12-10 of the aforementioned Zoning Resolution, constitutes a covenant running with the land and inuring to the benefit of and binding on the heirs. successors, and assigns of the Declarants herein, and may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be an original and all of which shall constitute one and the same instrument.
